Beta art check-in

Every piece of art the beta still needs, with five options each. All drafts are drawn on the game's own pixel grid with the approved frame ladder, coins, items and stars, so they look the way they would in the game. Nothing here is in the game yet. Pick one letter per item.

B1 Starlight iconB2 Verdant Reverie setB3 Heartwood HaloB4 Core PulseB5 Common and Epic loose itemsB6 Achievement stickersB7 Skill tree nodes and star chart

B1 Starlight icon

The Ascension currency, in the header and the Starlight shop. 48 x 48, built on the approved coin rims (ink, sticker ring, rim metal, dark well).

A

Silver star coin

Approved coin rim in moon silver, one faceted four-point star in pale gold. Closest to the gem coins.

B

Night coin

Rim recoloured night indigo with the gold ring kept, a starry well and a five-point gold star.

C

Bare star

No coin: an eight-point faceted star with the white sticker ring. Its silhouette never reads as a gem coin.

D

Prismatic coin

The Prismatic-tier rim with a moonlit lilac star. Reads as the step beyond Prismatic.

E

Constellation coin

Gold rim, a dark well with five linked stars. Ties to the constellation skill tree; weakest at small size.

B2 Verdant Reverie set

The whole set on Elder Treant at Prismatic (the rank that wears both border and finish), then its five global items. Shown as a Legendary set (max level 5): L1 shape, L2 accent, L3 gems, L4 glow, L5 drifting petals. Flourishes stay in the corner zones, reach at most 10 px past the edge, tuck under the frame's corner sockets and never enter the stars band.

A

Leaf crown

Three broad leaves fan out of each corner; dew drops and lime sprigs, an emerald, then a pale green halo and pink petals. Finish: a leaf-vein lattice.

B3 Heartwood Halo

Card-exclusive border for Moonwood Dryad, worn from Prismatic 6 stars. Mythic, so five levels: shape, accent (moon silver and gold), moonstones, glow, ambient motes. The tier crest and all six sockets stay on top.

A

Crescent cradles

Heartwood crescents cradle each corner, silver inlay, moonstones at the tips. Reads as a halo split into four moons.

B

Moonwood antlers

Silver-barked moonwood branches fork out of the corners like antlers, gold leaves, moonstones at the forks.

C

Growth rings

Growth rings: quarter-arcs of heartwood rings around each corner, gold inner rings, one moonstone at the heart.

D

Luna moths

A luna moth rests on each corner, pink eye spots and gold dots, a moonstone body. The most animal-like.

E

Moon wreath

A thin moon-silver arc with laurel leaves, a gold crescent, pink gems. The lightest, closest to a real halo.

B4 Core Pulse

Card-exclusive finish for Core Titan, worn from Prismatic 6 stars. Exotic, so six levels: shape, more shape, violet accent, core gems, glow, ambient pulse. The finish sits under the item and the text, and stays out of the stars band.

A

Pulse rings

Concentric rings around the gauntlet; L6 sends a pulse outward ring by ring.

B

Power veins

Branching power veins from the core, hot violet roots and node sparks; L6 runs light along the veins.

C

Hex core

A hex lattice that grows from the core outward, a faceted core gem; L6 lights the hexes in waves.

D

Magma strata

Wavy magma strata across the lower window, ember gems in the seams; L6 lets heat specks rise.

E

Starburst

Dotted rays from a star-cut core behind the gauntlet; L6 turns the rays half a step back and forth.

B5 Common and Epic loose items

Proposed pool so the Wardrobe Gate can roll Common and Epic: a Common border and Common numbers (max 2: shape, then a twinkle), an Epic attack and Epic tick (max 4: shape, accent, gem and glow, ambient sparks). The style options below set the look for all four; names follow the style.

A

Forge

Iron and brass: riveted brackets, stamped numerals, a steel slash with a brass core.

B

Woodcraft

Carved wood and twine: twine-bound corners, carved numerals, a wood-shaving cut.

C

Star chart

Ink and silver: compass-star corners, silver numerals, a comet slash in starlight blue.

D

Candy enamel

Candy enamel: gumdrop corners, candy numerals, a pink ribbon swipe with a blue core.

E

Runestone

Runestone: carved stone corner blocks, rune-green highlights, a stone cleave with a glowing core.

B6 Achievement stickers

Sticker style for the 25 achievements in the sticker book (A10 C). 48 x 48, one glyph per achievement, colour by category (production green, combat red, stars gold, cards violet, night blue). Six examples plus a not-earned sticker.

A

Die-cut

The glyph alone with a thick white sticker edge, like a real die-cut sticker.

B

Round badge

A domed disc in the category colour with a lit rim, the glyph on top.

C

Shield crest

A two-tone heraldic shield with a gold edge; pairs with the Knight plate frame.

D

Postage stamp

A perforated white stamp edge around a coloured field; the book reads as a stamp album.

E

Holo seal

A scalloped seal with a rainbow rim; the most prized look, close to the Prismatic language.

B7 Skill tree nodes and star chart

Faceted gem nodes for the radial constellation (A8 A), one colour per branch, in three states, plus the card enhancement star chart where owned links are solid and open links dashed. 24 px nodes, 32 px keystones.

A

Brilliant in a bronze cup

A round brilliant cut set in a bronze cup, like the gem coins. Calm, heavy, very readable.

How to answer

One letter per item. Mixing is fine (for example "B2 A, but with E's blossoms").

reply like: B1 C, B2 A, B3 D, B4 B, B5 A, B6 E, B7 D

Assumptions to confirm with your picks: Verdant Reverie is treated as a Legendary set (5 levels). Heartwood Halo is Mythic (5 levels) and Core Pulse Exotic (6 levels), matching their cards. The B5 pool is a Common border, Common numbers, Epic attack and Epic tick; say if you want other slots. Cards show their item at the game's 0.75 item scale, and text is live text, as in the game.
